Pins FORMAT §7.1 (D71 rule 1 and 2): a `d` estimate starts on a weekday. Pre (5d, today Mon) is Mon 03-01 .. Fri 03-05.
Post starts the day after Pre, Sat 03-06, which moves to Mon 03-08; 2d ends Tue 03-09. Late has a date start, Sat 03-06
(after: DATE), which also moves to Mon 03-08; 3d (Mon, Tue, Wed) ends Wed 03-10.
